name: charlie947/social-media-skills
description: A social media video skill collection. Draft scope is the youtube-thumbnail skill folder only: it builds a branded YouTube thumbnail from a video title, a reference photo of the creator, high-CTR thumbnail principles, and brand colours, producing a ready-to-generate image prompt for Gemini. Note: Requires user-supplied API credentials for external data access.
install: Claude Code plugin route (/plugin marketplace add charlie947/social-media-skills, /plugin install social-media-skills), or git clone plus copy of a skill folder to the agent skills directory (Codex copy script documented in README)
